name: NeRF-VPT
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields via View Prompt Tuning
definition: A cascading view prompt tuning paradigm for novel view synthesis that uses RGB information from preceding rendering iterations as visual prompts for subsequent stages to progressively enhance image quality.
summary: NeRF-VPT is a cascading view prompt tuning method for novel view synthesis that progressively enhances image quality by using rendered RGB images from previous stages as visual prompts for subsequent iterations.
